comment: Hands-down the best professor in University of Richmond's SPCS program. Russ is extremely knowledgeable and always willing to go above and beyond for his students. He  incorporates real-world application into each of his lessons thus providing students with the tools necessary to be successful in their careers. U of R is lucky to have him!
Brought practical experience to the classroom.  Little hard to stay awake-monotone....but, good class overall.
